append_findings.claim: 064 reports gamma 0.20 as the only admissible sandwich knockdown, with the named CR-1457 hemisphere limit. All eight concept and TRL 7 payloads at that gamma are negative. The review half reproduced all eight cells and named no fix.
append_findings.qualification: Sciences admitted the review with limits: shared-model reproduction, so the independent-derivation requirement is unmet; shared assumptions, including NFI065-BETA-SCALE, are not independently cleared; 2014-T6 on glass-fabric is the flight bulkhead and the SDL 468 specimen materials remain unverified. The one-round result stands with those limits. No installed hull safety factor is released. QUESTIONABLE inputs. PROJECTION payloads.

append_findings.claim: 065's source check reproduces. The only admissible Q is 0.33, CR-1457 equation 2.2-14, with that named limit. Q 0.82 is not an installed value. The favorable gamma ramp is not admissible. T3 and T7 are the tests that could show a better coefficient.
append_findings.qualification: No installed hull safety factor is released. QUESTIONABLE inputs. PROJECTION payloads.
